title: The Trees and the Axe
summary: A woodman walked into an ancient forest and begged the trees to grant him a single piece of hardwood to fashion a handle for his iron axe head....
full_text:
A woodman walked into an ancient forest and begged the trees to grant him a single piece of hardwood to fashion a handle for his iron axe head.

The noble oak and pine trees took pity on him and graciously gave him a branch of plain ash wood.

The woodman fitted the handle to his axe and immediately began cutting down the magnificent oaks, pines, and beeches, laying the forest bare.

The dying oak wept to the cedar: "Our own foolish charity provided the weapon that destroys us all!"
moral: Giving your enemy the means to hurt your brother leads swiftly to your own destruction.
